# DadMeals // Zero Fluff Cooking
> High-efficiency, zero-fluff cooking instructions for air fryer and dad meals. Built for speed, clarity, and instant execution without life stories.

## Full Dataset
- [Full Recipe Library (Markdown)](https://dadmeals.com/llms-full.txt): Complete uncompressed database of all 40+ recipes in markdown format.

## Categories
- [Air Fryer Staples](https://dadmeals.com/categories/air-fryer): Zero oil mess. Maximum crunch in under 15 minutes.
- [15-Minute Meals](https://dadmeals.com/categories/15-minute): From fridge to table before the kids start melting down.
- [High Protein / Lean](https://dadmeals.com/categories/high-protein): Steak, chicken, salmon, and ground beef macros that fill the family.
- [Kid & Toddler Approved](https://dadmeals.com/categories/kid-approved): Unanimous dinner table approvals. Zero vegetable negotiations.
- [Budget & Pantry Staples](https://dadmeals.com/categories/budget): Under $12 total meal costs using everyday ingredients.
- [Rapid Sides & Veggies](https://dadmeals.com/categories/sides): Crispy broccoli, asparagus, fries, and garlic toast in 8 minutes.
- [Game Day & Late Night](https://dadmeals.com/categories/snacks): Taquitos, bagel pizzas, wings, and mozzarella sticks.
- [Weekend Dad Classics](https://dadmeals.com/categories/weekend-dad): Fluffy buttermilk pancakes, smash burgers, and cast-iron steaks.

## Appliance Guides
- [Air Fryer Cooking Guide](https://dadmeals.com/appliances/air-fryer): Convection heat in a compact basket. Cuts cooking time by 40% and produces extreme crispiness.
- [Sheet Pan Cooking Guide](https://dadmeals.com/appliances/sheet-pan): Feed the whole crew on one single parchment-lined pan. Zero sink full of pots.
- [Skillet & Pan Guide](https://dadmeals.com/appliances/skillet): High-speed stovetop searing and 15-minute quick sauces.
- [Cast Iron Guide](https://dadmeals.com/appliances/cast-iron): Extreme thermal mass for diner-crust smash burgers and restaurant-grade steak sears.
- [One-Pot Dutch Oven Guide](https://dadmeals.com/appliances/one-pot): Brown the meat, dump the pasta or broth, cover and serve from one vessel.
- [Outdoor Grill Guide](https://dadmeals.com/appliances/grill): Charcoal or propane high heat for weekend family barbecues.

## Key Tools
- [Air Fryer Time & Temp Calculator](https://dadmeals.com/air-fryer-calculator): Convert conventional oven recipes to air fryer times and temps.
- [Air Fryer Cheat Sheet](https://dadmeals.com/cheat-sheet): Quick 1-page temperature reference matrix.
